author: silko
text_post: 1st date tips for introverts Hey, Im a natural introvert. Working with creative stuff like writing im usually a deep thinker and a lot inside my head. Do you have any flirting and conversations tips to spark attraction on a 1st date with a girl as an introvert?

author: Rio
text_post: 90% of the guys on here are probably natural introverts. not a problem * write down 3 things you love and know a lot about. Those are your go-tos * cultivate genuine curiosity. go into every interaction open to finding out about people and new things * remove the filter. build the habit of saying what's on your mind. this goes for general thoughts ("u know what i love? bowling!"; "hey did u see that movie XYZ?") and for feelings that come up regarding her ("ur so fucking sexy"; "it was really cute when you did X"). Don't wait for the right moment to do anything, do it whenever u feel like it. and the most important tip for dates: set it up properly. avoid lunch, dinner, coffee, movie. make sure you're sitting next to her, NOT across a table. ideally at night, NOT a crowded place, and NOT watching a show. the date is about u and her, not the dude on stage/screen and keep it cheap. dont break the fucking bank. good defaults are a) drinks b) playing pool c) watching a movie at ur place (I know i said above "no movie" but if its at ur pad its great, at the theater it blows)

author: gq1
text_post: This feels like the heart of all the love system courses.  Tips may help a little bit, but what you really need is a blueprint + practice. That said, "removing the filter" is awesome advice.  If it's going through your head, share it.  the worst that can happen is she learns about the real you.
